title: Ritu Project — Carboplatin AUC ≥ 3 Cohort (Local/Early)
text:
Ritu cohort — Local/Early stage only. This page repeats the Jiaxuan carboplatin AUC ≥ 3 analysis on the subset of patients with tumor_stage == "Local/Early", leaving N = 142 patients. tumor_stage is dropped from Table 1 and from every adjuster set because it is constant within this cohort.
steroids is also dropped from the adjuster sets on this page only. All 142 patients in this subgroup received steroids, so the variable is constant and collinear with the intercept. Together with an emptied cancer_type_cat_7 “GI” level (cleared by droplevels() after the cohort filter) it made the design matrix rank-deficient, which caused cmprsk::crr to fail regardless of event count. steroids is retained as a descriptive row in Table 1. The whole and carboplatin cohorts are full rank and keep the original adjuster set.
Only the long-horizon kidney outcomes are modelled on this page. AKI within 1 year and the CKD composite are carried through Fine-Gray competing-risk models in Section 5, with death at any time as the competing event. The 90-day adverse-event, hospitalization and 90-day-death models this page used to carry have been removed; those outcomes are still derived in Data Management and remain in the saved master, they are simply no longer modelled. Read both models with their event counts in view — 12 AKI and 7 CKD-composite events in 142 patients against ~20 covariate degrees of freedom, so both are over-parameterised. See RITU_PROJECT.md.

title: Ritu Project — Carboplatin AUC ≥ 3 Cohort (Local/Early)
text:
2.2 Signed Dose Discrepancy Distribution
Smooth kernel density estimate of the signed dose discrepancy (actual − predicted, CKD-EPI Cr-Cys). The area under the curve is shaded by sign — negative (under-dosed region) on one side, positive on the other.


Code
dose_vals <- dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(dose_discrepancy)) %>%
  pull(dose_discrepancy)

dens <- density(dose_vals, n = 512)
y_at_zero <- approx(dens$x, dens$y, xout = 0)$y

dens_df <- tibble(x = dens$x, y = dens$y) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(x = 0, y = y_at_zero)) %>%
  arrange(x)

neg_part <- dens_df %>% filter(x <= 0) %>% mutate(side = "neg")
pos_part <- dens_df %>% filter(x >= 0) %>% mutate(side = "pos")
plot_df  <- bind_rows(neg_part, pos_part)

ggplot() +
  geom_area(data = plot_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = side), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = dens_df, aes(x = x, y = y), linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 25, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(neg = "#E31A1C", pos = "grey60"),
                    guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-250, 250), ylim = c(0, 0.010)) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Signed Dose Discrepancy (Carboplatin AUC ≥ 3)",
       x = "Dose Discrepancy (mg) = Actual dose – Predicted dose",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

title: Ritu Project — Carboplatin AUC ≥ 3 Cohort (Local/Early)
text:
3.2 Long-Horizon Kidney Outcomes (CKD / ESKD / AKI)
Ported from the ICI-CKD project and built in Sections 5.16–5.19 of Data Management. Creatinine for these comes from the Ritu_project RPDR pull (Oct 2026).

None of these are censored at 90 days. A qualifying CKD episode has to be sustained for ≥ 90 days, so they run over the full length of RPDR creatinine follow-up. aki is restricted to events within 1 year. This section reports all of them descriptively; aki and ckd_composite are the two that are modelled — see the Fine-Gray section below. The rest are descriptive only.

Definitions as of the latest revision. aki is now restricted to events within 1 year of baseline (aki_any keeps the unrestricted count for reference and is not modelled). ckd_incidence uses a > 25 % eGFR drop; ckd_incidence_any drops the percent requirement entirely; ckd_progression now additionally requires a > 30 % further drop, where it previously counted any patient who was simply below 60 before and after — which flagged stable CKD as progression and is why that count fell sharply.
aki is also not the same variable as AKI_g2_90days / AKI_kdigo_90days: it compares each creatinine against the patient’s own preceding 90-day median (or 2-day low) rather than against a fixed pre-baseline value. The cross-tabulation below shows how far the two diverge.
📄 Download Word table


Code
.kid_row <- function(flag, time_var, label) {
  n <- sum(dat[[flag]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  tt <- if (!is.null(time_var) && time_var %in% names(dat))
          dat[[time_var]][dat[[flag]] == 1] else NA_real_
  tibble::tibble(
    Outcome = label,
    `n (%)` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / nrow(dat)),
    `Median days to event (IQR)` = if (n > 0 && any(!is.na(tt)))
        sprintf("%.0f (%.0f-%.0f)", median(tt, na.rm = TRUE),
                quantile(tt, .25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(tt, .75, na.rm = TRUE))
      else "-"
  )
}

kidney_lt <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .kid_row("aki",               "aki_days",                    "AKI within 1 year (serial creatinine)"),
  .kid_row("aki_any",           "aki_days_any",                "AKI at any time (reference only, not modelled)"),
  .kid_row("ckd_incidence",     "time_to_ckd_incidence",       "CKD incidence (>25% eGFR drop to <60, sustained >=90d)"),
  .kid_row("ckd_incidence_any", "time_to_ckd_incidence_any",   "CKD incidence any (>=60 to <60, sustained >=90d, no % drop)"),
  .kid_row("ckd_progression",   "time_to_ckd_progression",     "CKD progression (<60 at baseline, further >30% drop, sustained >=90d)"),
  .kid_row("eskd_defination_1", NULL,                          "ESKD (eGFR <10, sustained >=90d)"),
  .kid_row("esrd_kt_after_ici", NULL,                          "ESRD / kidney transplant after baseline"),
  .kid_row("eskd_composite",    "time_to_eskd_composite",      "ESKD composite"),
  .kid_row("ckd_composite",     "time_to_ckd_composite",       "CKD composite (incidence + progression + ESKD composite)")
)

ft_kid <- flextable::flextable(kidney_lt) |>
  flextable::set_caption(sprintf(
    "Long-horizon kidney outcomes (N = %d). Not censored at 90 days.", nrow(dat))) |>
  flextable::autofit()
flextable::save_as_docx(ft_kid, path = file.path(docx_dir, "sec3_kidney_longhorizon.docx"))

NoteWhy anchor at the median (subHR = 1 at the reference)



Three reasons to anchor at the median:

Interpretability: “A patient with eGFR ratio of 0.8 has ~1.5× the subHR compared to a typical patient (at the median).”
Stability: The median sits in the densest part of the data, so estimates near it have the tightest confidence intervals. The CIs fan out as you move away — you can see this in the plots.
No arbitrary choice: If we picked 1.0 arbitrarily, the plot would look almost identical here (because median ≈ 1), but in cohorts where the median is 0.9 or 1.1, picking 1.0 would either shift or distort the curve without changing the actual model.

section: 10.0 Summary table: Fine-Gray subHR per 10 mL/min decline in eGFR discrepancy
text:
10.0 Summary table: Fine-Gray subHR per 10 mL/min decline in eGFR discrepancy
One row per outcome. Multivariable Fine-Gray model fit with egfr_disc_per10dec = -egfr_discrepancy / 10 (positive when CKD-EPI Cr-Cys is below CG) plus the same adjusters used by the curves below (no platin_group in the AUC ≥ 3 cohort). The HR for egfr_disc_per10dec is the multiplicative change in subHR per 10 mL/min lower eGFR discrepancy. 90-day death uses Cox PH. p-values in this summary table are raw Wald (not Bonferroni-adjusted); the plot subtitles in Sections 10.1–10.11 apply Bonferroni correction across the six primary AE outcomes.
📄 Download Word table

.disc_adj_set <- function(pre_labs = NULL) {
  base_adj <- c("age","sex","score","ecog_score_cat2",
                "cancer_type_cat_7","high_dose",
                "Paclitaxel","Pemetrexed","Gemcitabine","ici",
                "bmi","smoking","thyroid")
  if (!is.null(pre_labs)) base_adj <- c(base_adj, pre_labs)
  base_adj
}

fg_disc_row <- function(time_var, status_var, label, pre_labs = NULL) {
  adj <- .disc_adj_set(pre_labs)
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c("egfr_disc_per10dec", time_var, status_var, adj))) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  adj_df <- d[, adj, drop = FALSE]
  X_adj  <- model.matrix(~ ., data = adj_df)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  X      <- cbind(egfr_disc_per10dec = d$egfr_disc_per10dec, X_adj)
  stat_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(d[[status_var]])))
  time_num <- as.numeric(d[[time_var]])
  fit <- cmprsk::crr(time_num, stat_num, cov1 = X, failcode = 1)
  b <- unname(fit$coef[1]); se <- sqrt(fit$var[1, 1])
  hr <- exp(b); lcl <- exp(b - 1.96 * se); ucl <- exp(b + 1.96 * se)
  pv <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(b / se)))
  tibble(
    Outcome = label,
    Model   = "Fine-Gray",
    N       = nrow(d),
    `Excluded (missing cov.)` = nrow(dat) - nrow(d),
    Events  = sum(stat_num == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `(sub)HR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", hr, lcl, ucl),
    `p-value` = ifelse(pv < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pv))
  )
}
# Ritu: guard against unfittable sparse-outcome models.
fg_disc_row <- .wrap_row(fg_disc_row)


cox_disc_row <- function(time_var, status_var, label, pre_labs = NULL) {
  adj <- .disc_adj_set(pre_labs)
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c("egfr_disc_per10dec", time_var, status_var, adj))) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", status_var,
                            ") ~ egfr_disc_per10dec + ",
                            paste(adj, collapse = " + ")))
  fit <- survival::coxph(fmla, data = d)
  b   <- unname(coef(fit)["egfr_disc_per10dec"])
  se  <- sqrt(vcov(fit)["egfr_disc_per10dec", "egfr_disc_per10dec"])
  hr  <- exp(b); lcl <- exp(b - 1.96 * se); ucl <- exp(b + 1.96 * se)
  pv  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(b / se)))
  tibble(
    Outcome = label,
    Model   = "Cox PH",
    N       = nrow(d),
    `Excluded (missing cov.)` = nrow(dat) - nrow(d),
    Events  = sum(d[[status_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `(sub)HR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", hr, lcl, ucl),
    `p-value` = ifelse(pv < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pv))
  )
}
# Ritu: guard against unfittable sparse-outcome models.
cox_disc_row <- .wrap_row(cox_disc_row)

plot_subhr_linear_egfrdisc <- function(time_var, status_var, extra_adj = NULL,
                                       outcome_label, n_bonf = 6) {
  base_adj <- c("age","sex","score","ecog_score_cat2",
                "cancer_type_cat_7","high_dose",
                "Paclitaxel","Pemetrexed","Gemcitabine","ici",
                "bmi","smoking","thyroid")
  keep <- c("egfr_discrepancy", time_var, status_var, base_adj, extra_adj)
  d <- dat %>% dplyr::select(all_of(keep)) %>% tidyr::drop_na()

  adj_df <- d[, c(base_adj, extra_adj), drop = FALSE]
  X_adj <- model.matrix(~ ., data = adj_df)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  X <- cbind(egfr_discrepancy = d$egfr_discrepancy, X_adj)

  stat_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(d[[status_var]])))
  time_num <- as.numeric(d[[time_var]])

  fit <- cmprsk::crr(ftime = time_num, fstatus = stat_num,
                     cov1 = X, failcode = 1)

  beta   <- fit$coef[1]
  V_beta <- fit$var[1, 1]
  se_b   <- sqrt(V_beta)

  q1    <- as.numeric(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))
  q3    <- as.numeric(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  iqr_w <- q3 - q1
  hr10  <- exp(-10 * beta);       hr10_l <- exp(-10 * beta - 1.96 * 10 * se_b);     hr10_u <- exp(-10 * beta + 1.96 * 10 * se_b)
  hri   <- exp(-iqr_w * beta);    hri_l <- exp(-iqr_w * beta - 1.96 * abs(iqr_w) * se_b); hri_u <- exp(-iqr_w * beta + 1.96 * abs(iqr_w) * se_b)
  pval  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(beta / se_b)))
  pval_bonf <- min(pval * n_bonf, 1)
  p_shown <- if (n_bonf > 1) pval_bonf else pval
  p_lbl   <- if (n_bonf > 1) sprintf("p_Bonf = %s (n = %d)", ifelse(p_shown < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_shown)), n_bonf) else sprintf("p = %s", ifelse(p_shown < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_shown)))
  subtitle_str <- sprintf(
    "subHR per 10 mL/min decline: %.2f (%.2f-%.2f), %s  |  per IQR decline (Δ = %.1f): %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)  |  IQR: [%.1f, %.1f]",
    hr10, hr10_l, hr10_u, p_lbl, iqr_w, hri, hri_l, hri_u, q1, q3)

  ref_x  <- median(d$egfr_discrepancy, na.rm = TRUE)
  grid_x <- seq(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100)

  log_hr <- beta * (grid_x - ref_x)
  se     <- sqrt((grid_x - ref_x)^2 * V_beta)

  df_plot <- tibble(
    x     = grid_x,
    subhr = exp(log_hr),
    lcl   = exp(log_hr - 1.96 * se),
    ucl   = exp(log_hr + 1.96 * se)
  )

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = subhr)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), alpha = 0.2, fill = "darkorange") +
    geom_line(color = "darkorange", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ref_x, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(q1, q3), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "eGFR Discrepancy (mL/min)",
         y = "subHR (95% CI)",
         title = outcome_label,
         subtitle = subtitle_str) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey25"))
}
# Ritu: guard against unfittable sparse-outcome models.
plot_subhr_linear_egfrdisc <- .wrap_plot(plot_subhr_linear_egfrdisc)

title: Ritu Project — Whole Cohort (Local/Early)
text:
Ritu cohort — Local/Early stage only. This page repeats the Jiaxuan whole-cohort analysis on the subset of patients with tumor_stage == "Local/Early" (stage I–II / local / neoadjuvant). All 621 advanced/metastatic patients are excluded, leaving N = 322 (189 carboplatin, 133 cisplatin). tumor_stage is dropped from Table 1 and from every adjuster set because it is constant within this cohort. The exposure and the adjuster set are otherwise unchanged from the Jiaxuan project.
Only the long-horizon kidney outcomes are modelled on this page. AKI within 1 year and the CKD composite are carried through Fine-Gray competing-risk models in Section 4, with death at any time as the competing event. The 90-day adverse-event, hospitalization and 90-day-death models this page used to carry have been removed; those outcomes are still derived in Data Management and remain in the saved master, they are simply no longer modelled. Read both models with their event counts in view — 51 AKI and 26 CKD-composite events in 322 patients against ~20 covariate degrees of freedom, so both are over-parameterised. See RITU_PROJECT.md.

title: Ritu Project — Whole Cohort (Local/Early)
section: 2.1 Follow-up time (days from baseline to last known status)
text:
2.1 Follow-up time (days from baseline to last known status)
days_last_follow_up = last_follow_up_date − baseline_sample_date. Two alternative definitions of “follow-up time” are shown side-by-side so the reader can pick the most defensible one for their purpose:

A — Raw days: unrestricted calendar follow-up (median dominated by patients who kept returning for years).
B — Raw days, ≤ 365 days: restricts to patients whose last-known contact was within 1 year of baseline (drops the long tail of years-later return visits; more comparable across patients).



Code
followup_summary <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(record_id, platin_group, days_last_follow_up) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(days_last_follow_up)

fmt_med_iqr <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return("—")
  sprintf("%.0f [%.0f, %.0f]", median(x), quantile(x, 0.25), quantile(x, 0.75))
}

groups_split <- function(f) {
  x_all <- f(followup_summary$days_last_follow_up)
  x_cis <- f(followup_summary$days_last_follow_up[followup_summary$platin_group == "Cisplatin"])
  x_car <- f(followup_summary$days_last_follow_up[followup_summary$platin_group == "Carboplatin"])
  list(Overall = x_all, Cisplatin = x_cis, Carboplatin = x_car)
}

fu_row <- function(label, xs) {
  tibble::tibble(
    Interpretation                      = label,
    `Overall N`                         = length(xs$Overall),
    `Overall — Median [IQR] (days)`     = fmt_med_iqr(xs$Overall),
    `Cisplatin N`                       = length(xs$Cisplatin),
    `Cisplatin — Median [IQR] (days)`   = fmt_med_iqr(xs$Cisplatin),
    `Carboplatin N`                     = length(xs$Carboplatin),
    `Carboplatin — Median [IQR] (days)` = fmt_med_iqr(xs$Carboplatin)
  )
}

def_A <- function(v) v
def_B <- function(v) v[v <= 365]

followup_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  fu_row("A — Raw days",             groups_split(def_A)),
  fu_row("B — Raw days, ≤ 365 days", groups_split(def_B))
)

flextable::flextable(followup_tbl) |>
  flextable::set_caption("Follow-up time from baseline to last known status (whole cohort). Two alternative definitions shown side-by-side.") |>
  flextable::autofit()

title: Ritu Project — Whole Cohort (Local/Early)
text:
2.2 Long-Horizon Kidney Outcomes (CKD / ESKD / AKI)
Ported from the ICI-CKD project and built in Sections 5.16–5.19 of Data Management. Creatinine for these comes from the Ritu_project RPDR pull (Oct 2026).

None of these are censored at 90 days. A qualifying CKD episode has to be sustained for ≥ 90 days, so they run over the full length of RPDR creatinine follow-up. aki is restricted to events within 1 year. This section reports all of them descriptively; aki and ckd_composite are the two that are modelled — see the Fine-Gray section below. The rest are descriptive only.

Definitions as of the latest revision. aki is now restricted to events within 1 year of baseline (aki_any keeps the unrestricted count for reference and is not modelled). ckd_incidence uses a > 25 % eGFR drop; ckd_incidence_any drops the percent requirement entirely; ckd_progression now additionally requires a > 30 % further drop, where it previously counted any patient who was simply below 60 before and after — which flagged stable CKD as progression and is why that count fell sharply.
aki is also not the same variable as AKI_g2_90days / AKI_kdigo_90days: it compares each creatinine against the patient’s own preceding 90-day median (or 2-day low) rather than against a fixed pre-baseline value. The cross-tabulation below shows how far the two diverge.
📄 Download Word table


Code
.kid_row <- function(flag, time_var, label) {
  n <- sum(dat[[flag]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  tt <- if (!is.null(time_var) && time_var %in% names(dat))
          dat[[time_var]][dat[[flag]] == 1] else NA_real_
  tibble::tibble(
    Outcome = label,
    `n (%)` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / nrow(dat)),
    `Median days to event (IQR)` = if (n > 0 && any(!is.na(tt)))
        sprintf("%.0f (%.0f-%.0f)", median(tt, na.rm = TRUE),
                quantile(tt, .25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(tt, .75, na.rm = TRUE))
      else "-"
  )
}

kidney_lt <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .kid_row("aki",               "aki_days",                    "AKI within 1 year (serial creatinine)"),
  .kid_row("aki_any",           "aki_days_any",                "AKI at any time (reference only, not modelled)"),
  .kid_row("ckd_incidence",     "time_to_ckd_incidence",       "CKD incidence (>25% eGFR drop to <60, sustained >=90d)"),
  .kid_row("ckd_incidence_any", "time_to_ckd_incidence_any",   "CKD incidence any (>=60 to <60, sustained >=90d, no % drop)"),
  .kid_row("ckd_progression",   "time_to_ckd_progression",     "CKD progression (<60 at baseline, further >30% drop, sustained >=90d)"),
  .kid_row("eskd_defination_1", NULL,                          "ESKD (eGFR <10, sustained >=90d)"),
  .kid_row("esrd_kt_after_ici", NULL,                          "ESRD / kidney transplant after baseline"),
  .kid_row("eskd_composite",    "time_to_eskd_composite",      "ESKD composite"),
  .kid_row("ckd_composite",     "time_to_ckd_composite",       "CKD composite (incidence + progression + ESKD composite)")
)

ft_kid <- flextable::flextable(kidney_lt) |>
  flextable::set_caption(sprintf(
    "Long-horizon kidney outcomes (N = %d). Not censored at 90 days.", nrow(dat))) |>
  flextable::autofit()

section: 7.0 Summary table: Fine-Gray subHR per 10 mL/min decline in eGFR discrepancy
text:
7.0 Summary table: Fine-Gray subHR per 10 mL/min decline in eGFR discrepancy
One row per outcome. Multivariable Fine-Gray model fit with egfr_disc_per10dec = -egfr_discrepancy / 10 (positive when CKD-EPI Cr-Cys is below CG) plus the same adjusters used by the curves below. The HR for egfr_disc_per10dec is the multiplicative change in subHR per 10 mL/min lower eGFR discrepancy. 90-day death uses Cox PH (no competing event); all other outcomes use Fine-Gray with death as the competing event. p-values in this summary table are raw Wald (not Bonferroni-adjusted); the plot subtitles in Sections 7.1–7.11 apply Bonferroni correction across the six primary AE outcomes.
📄 Download Word table


Code
.disc_adj_set <- function(pre_labs = NULL) {
  base_adj <- c("age","sex","score","ecog_score_cat2",
                "cancer_type_cat_7","platin_group","high_dose",
                "Paclitaxel","Pemetrexed","Gemcitabine","ici",
                "bmi","smoking","steroids","thyroid")
  if (!is.null(pre_labs)) base_adj <- c(base_adj, pre_labs)
  base_adj
}

fg_disc_row <- function(time_var, status_var, label, pre_labs = NULL) {
  adj <- .disc_adj_set(pre_labs)
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c("egfr_disc_per10dec", time_var, status_var, adj))) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  adj_df <- d[, adj, drop = FALSE]
  X_adj  <- model.matrix(~ ., data = adj_df)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  X      <- cbind(egfr_disc_per10dec = d$egfr_disc_per10dec, X_adj)
  stat_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(d[[status_var]])))
  time_num <- as.numeric(d[[time_var]])
  fit <- cmprsk::crr(time_num, stat_num, cov1 = X, failcode = 1)
  b <- unname(fit$coef[1]); se <- sqrt(fit$var[1, 1])
  hr <- exp(b); lcl <- exp(b - 1.96 * se); ucl <- exp(b + 1.96 * se)
  pv <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(b / se)))
  tibble(
    Outcome = label,
    Model   = "Fine-Gray",
    N       = nrow(d),
    `Excluded (missing cov.)` = nrow(dat) - nrow(d),
    Events  = sum(stat_num == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `(sub)HR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", hr, lcl, ucl),
    `p-value` = ifelse(pv < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pv))
  )
}
# Ritu: guard against unfittable sparse-outcome models.
fg_disc_row <- .wrap_row(fg_disc_row)


cox_disc_row <- function(time_var, status_var, label, pre_labs = NULL) {
  adj <- .disc_adj_set(pre_labs)
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c("egfr_disc_per10dec", time_var, status_var, adj))) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", status_var,
                            ") ~ egfr_disc_per10dec + ",
                            paste(adj, collapse = " + ")))
  fit <- survival::coxph(fmla, data = d)
  b   <- unname(coef(fit)["egfr_disc_per10dec"])
  se  <- sqrt(vcov(fit)["egfr_disc_per10dec", "egfr_disc_per10dec"])
  hr  <- exp(b); lcl <- exp(b - 1.96 * se); ucl <- exp(b + 1.96 * se)
  pv  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(b / se)))
  tibble(
    Outcome = label,
    Model   = "Cox PH",
    N       = nrow(d),
    `Excluded (missing cov.)` = nrow(dat) - nrow(d),
    Events  = sum(d[[status_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `(sub)HR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", hr, lcl, ucl),
    `p-value` = ifelse(pv < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pv))
  )
}
# Ritu: guard against unfittable sparse-outcome models.
cox_disc_row <- .wrap_row(cox_disc_row)

plot_subhr_linear_disc <- function(time_var, status_var, extra_adj = NULL,
                                   outcome_label, n_bonf = 6) {
  base_adj <- c("age","sex","score","ecog_score_cat2",
                "cancer_type_cat_7","platin_group","high_dose",
                "Paclitaxel","Pemetrexed","Gemcitabine","ici",
                "bmi","smoking","steroids","thyroid")
  keep <- c("egfr_discrepancy", time_var, status_var, base_adj, extra_adj)
  d <- dat %>% dplyr::select(all_of(keep)) %>% tidyr::drop_na()

  adj_df <- d[, c(base_adj, extra_adj), drop = FALSE]
  X_adj <- model.matrix(~ ., data = adj_df)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  X <- cbind(egfr_discrepancy = d$egfr_discrepancy, X_adj)

  stat_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(d[[status_var]])))
  time_num <- as.numeric(d[[time_var]])

  fit <- cmprsk::crr(ftime = time_num, fstatus = stat_num,
                     cov1 = X, failcode = 1)

  beta   <- fit$coef[1]
  V_beta <- fit$var[1, 1]
  se_b   <- sqrt(V_beta)

  # subHR summaries: per 1 mL/min, and per IQR (Q3 - Q1) of egfr_discrepancy
  q1    <- as.numeric(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))
  q3    <- as.numeric(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  iqr_w <- q3 - q1
  # per 10 mL/min DECLINE: HR = exp(-10 * beta); SE on log scale = 10 * se_b
  hr10  <- exp(-10 * beta);       hr10_l <- exp(-10 * beta - 1.96 * 10 * se_b);     hr10_u <- exp(-10 * beta + 1.96 * 10 * se_b)
  # per IQR DECLINE: HR = exp(-iqr_w * beta); SE on log scale = |iqr_w| * se_b
  hri   <- exp(-iqr_w * beta);    hri_l <- exp(-iqr_w * beta - 1.96 * abs(iqr_w) * se_b); hri_u <- exp(-iqr_w * beta + 1.96 * abs(iqr_w) * se_b)
  pval  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(beta / se_b)))
  pval_bonf <- min(pval * n_bonf, 1)
  p_shown <- if (n_bonf > 1) pval_bonf else pval
  p_lbl   <- if (n_bonf > 1) sprintf("p_Bonf = %s (n = %d)", ifelse(p_shown < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_shown)), n_bonf) else sprintf("p = %s", ifelse(p_shown < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_shown)))
  subtitle_str <- sprintf(
    "subHR per 10 mL/min decline: %.2f (%.2f-%.2f), %s  |  per IQR decline (Δ = %.1f): %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)  |  IQR: [%.1f, %.1f]",
    hr10, hr10_l, hr10_u, p_lbl, iqr_w, hri, hri_l, hri_u, q1, q3)

  ref_x  <- median(d$egfr_discrepancy, na.rm = TRUE)
  grid_x <- seq(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100)

  log_hr <- beta * (grid_x - ref_x)
  se     <- sqrt((grid_x - ref_x)^2 * V_beta)

  df_plot <- tibble(
    x     = grid_x,
    subhr = exp(log_hr),
    lcl   = exp(log_hr - 1.96 * se),
    ucl   = exp(log_hr + 1.96 * se)
  )

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = subhr)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), alpha = 0.2, fill = "darkorange") +
    geom_line(color = "darkorange", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ref_x, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(q1, q3), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "eGFR Discrepancy (mL/min)",
         y = "subHR (95% CI)",
         title = outcome_label,
         subtitle = subtitle_str) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey25"))
}

plot_cox_linear_disc <- function(time_var, status_var, extra_adj = NULL,
                                 outcome_label, n_bonf = 6) {
  base_adj <- c("age","sex","score","ecog_score_cat2",
                "cancer_type_cat_7","platin_group","high_dose",
                "Paclitaxel","Pemetrexed","Gemcitabine","ici",
                "bmi","smoking","steroids","thyroid")
  keep <- c("egfr_discrepancy", time_var, status_var, base_adj, extra_adj)
  d <- dat %>% dplyr::select(all_of(keep)) %>% tidyr::drop_na()

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(", time_var, ", ", status_var, ") ~ egfr_discrepancy + ",
    paste(c(base_adj, extra_adj), collapse = " + ")
  ))
  fit <- survival::coxph(fmla, data = d)

  beta   <- coef(fit)["egfr_discrepancy"]
  V_beta <- vcov(fit)["egfr_discrepancy", "egfr_discrepancy"]
  se_b   <- sqrt(V_beta)

  q1    <- as.numeric(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE))
  q3    <- as.numeric(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  iqr_w <- q3 - q1
  hr10  <- exp(-10 * beta);       hr10_l <- exp(-10 * beta - 1.96 * 10 * se_b);     hr10_u <- exp(-10 * beta + 1.96 * 10 * se_b)
  hri   <- exp(-iqr_w * beta);    hri_l <- exp(-iqr_w * beta - 1.96 * abs(iqr_w) * se_b); hri_u <- exp(-iqr_w * beta + 1.96 * abs(iqr_w) * se_b)
  pval  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(beta / se_b)))
  pval_bonf <- min(pval * n_bonf, 1)
  p_shown <- if (n_bonf > 1) pval_bonf else pval
  p_lbl   <- if (n_bonf > 1) sprintf("p_Bonf = %s (n = %d)", ifelse(p_shown < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_shown)), n_bonf) else sprintf("p = %s", ifelse(p_shown < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_shown)))
  subtitle_str <- sprintf(
    "HR per 10 mL/min decline: %.2f (%.2f-%.2f), %s  |  per IQR decline (Δ = %.1f): %.2f (%.2f-%.2f)  |  IQR: [%.1f, %.1f]",
    hr10, hr10_l, hr10_u, p_lbl, iqr_w, hri, hri_l, hri_u, q1, q3)

  ref_x  <- median(d$egfr_discrepancy, na.rm = TRUE)
  grid_x <- seq(quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                quantile(d$egfr_discrepancy, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 100)

  log_hr <- beta * (grid_x - ref_x)
  se     <- sqrt((grid_x - ref_x)^2 * V_beta)

  df_plot <- tibble(
    x   = grid_x,
    hr  = exp(log_hr),
    lcl = exp(log_hr - 1.96 * se),
    ucl = exp(log_hr + 1.96 * se)
  )

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = hr)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl), alpha = 0.2, fill = "darkorange") +
    geom_line(color = "darkorange", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ref_x, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(q1, q3), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "eGFR Discrepancy (mL/min)",
         y = "HR (95% CI)",
         title = outcome_label,
         subtitle = subtitle_str) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey25"))
}

9.7 – 8.12 eGFR Difference (%) distribution by category
For each of the same six splits as 10.1 – 10.6, overlaid kernel density curves of the eGFR difference (%) = 100 × (CKD-EPI Cr-Cys unindexed − Cockcroft-Gault) / Cockcroft-Gault. Red = highlighted level (≥ threshold, or Female for the sex panel); grey = reference level. Dashed grey vertical line marks the 0 % concordance point; dotted verticals mark each group’s median. Subtitle carries N and median for each level plus a two-sided Mann-Whitney U p-value (equivalent to Wilcoxon rank-sum) comparing the two distributions.


Code
plot_ratio_by_group <- function(highlight_var, threshold, label,
                                highlight_label, reference_label) {
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(egfr_diff_pct), !is.na(.data[[highlight_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(grp = factor(
      ifelse(.data[[highlight_var]] >= threshold, highlight_label, reference_label),
      levels = c(highlight_label, reference_label)))

  med_tbl <- d %>%
    dplyr::group_by(grp) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(m = median(egfr_diff_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
                     n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  pval <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(egfr_diff_pct ~ grp, data = d)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_)
  p_str <- if (is.na(pval)) "NA" else
    ifelse(pval < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pval))

  col_vec <- setNames(c("#E31A1C", "grey50"),
                      c(highlight_label, reference_label))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = egfr_diff_pct, fill = grp, color = grp)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
    geom_vline(data = med_tbl, aes(xintercept = m, color = grp),
               linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_vec) +
    scale_color_manual(values = col_vec) +
    labs(x = "eGFR difference (%): 100 × (CKD-EPI Cr-Cys − CG) / CG",
         y = "Density",
         fill = NULL, color = NULL,
         title = label,
         subtitle = sprintf(
           "%s: N = %d, median = %.1f %%   |   %s: N = %d, median = %.1f %%   |   Mann-Whitney U p = %s",
           highlight_label,
           med_tbl$n[med_tbl$grp == highlight_label],
           med_tbl$m[med_tbl$grp == highlight_label],
           reference_label,
           med_tbl$n[med_tbl$grp == reference_label],
           med_tbl$m[med_tbl$grp == reference_label],
           p_str)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey25"))
}

title: Ritu Project — Data Management
text:
Ritu cohort — Local/Early stage only. This pipeline is the Jiaxuan data management pipeline with one added exclusion: all advanced/metastatic patients (tumor_stage == "Advanced/Metastatic", stage III–IV) are removed at the end of Section 5.20, leaving N = 322 (189 carboplatin, 133 cisplatin). Every variable definition, formula, window and exclusion above that step is unchanged. The analytic dataset is written to ritu_final_master.rds.
Inputs. The REDCap export is CystatinCInPatientsO_DATA_2026-10-09_1107.csv (refreshed 2026-10-09 with updated follow-up), read from its Dropbox path; Included Patients WHOLE cohort.csv still comes from ../Data/, and the RPDR .txt pulls from their original absolute paths. The refreshed export carries name, mgh_mrn and dob columns, which are dropped at read time in Section 4.1 and never enter the dataset, any table, or this site.

1.11 Derived — Carboplatin Dose Discrepancy
Carboplatin is dosed via the Calvert formula: Dose(mg) = target AUC × (GFR + 25). The actual administered dose is in REDCap. CKD-EPI Cr-Cys eGFR predicts what the dose should be — the discrepancy between actual and predicted may relate to adverse outcomes.

text:
1.13 Derived — Long-Horizon Kidney Outcomes (ported from the ICI-CKD project)
Built in Sections 5.16–5.19 from serial creatinine and RPDR diagnoses, following Kavita ICI CKD/data_management.qmd. Variable names are kept identical to that project so the two stay comparable; the index date is baseline_sample_date (first platinum) wherever the source used ICI_Dose_Date, which is what the _after_ici suffix refers to here.
Unlike every other outcome in this pipeline these are not censored at 90 days. A qualifying CKD episode must be sustained for ≥ 90 days, so they use the full length of RPDR creatinine follow-up.







In Code
Definition




eGFR_CRE_baseline
CKD-EPI creatinine eGFR at pre_CRE_45days (per-patient baseline)


ckd_stage_baseline
Numeric KDIGO stage 1–5 from eGFR_CRE_baseline


last_cre_date / last_cre_days
Date of, and days from baseline to, the last creatinine


aki / aki_date / aki_days
KDIGO-style AKI from serial CRE within 1 year of baseline: CRE > 1.5 × median of prior 90 d, or ≥ 0.3 mg/dL above the lowest value in the prior 2 d


aki_any / aki_date_any / aki_days_any
Same rule with no time limit — reference only, not modelled


ckd_incidence / _date
First sustained (≥ 90 d) episode with pct_drop > 0.25 & eGFR_CRE < 60 & eGFR_CRE_baseline >= 60


ckd_incidence_any / _date
First sustained (≥ 90 d) episode with eGFR_CRE < 60 & eGFR_CRE_baseline >= 60 — no percent-drop requirement


ckd_progression / _date
First sustained (≥ 90 d) episode with pct_drop > 0.30 & eGFR_CRE_baseline < 60


eskd_defination_1 / _date
First sustained (≥ 90 d) episode with eGFR_CRE < 10


esrd_kt
ESRD / kidney transplant / dialysis ICD code at or before baseline


esrd_kt_after_ici / _date
Same codes, first date after baseline


eskd_composite / _date
esrd_kt_after_ici == 1 \| eskd_defination_1 == 1; date = pmin() of the two


ckd_composite
eskd_composite == 1 \| ckd_incidence == 1 \| ckd_progression == 1


time_to_ckd_incidence / _progression / _eskd_composite / _ckd_composite
Days from baseline_sample_date to each event


aki_before_ckd
1 if aki_days <= time_to_ckd_composite


eGFR_CRE_d90 / _d180 / _d365
CKD-EPI creatinine eGFR from the creatinine closest to that day, within +/- 45 days (Section 5.16b)


cre_day_d90 / _d180 / _d365
The actual day of the creatinine used, so the gap from the nominal mark is auditable


delta_egfr_d90 / _d180 / _d365
eGFR at the mark - eGFR_CRE_baseline, mL/min/1.73m². Negative = decline


delta_egfr_pct_d90 / _d180 / _d365
The same change as a percentage of baseline. Negative = decline


dgfr_avail_d90 / _d180 / _d365
1 if the patient had a creatinine within +/- 45 days of that mark — the denominator behind each delta


n_cre_post
Number of post-baseline creatinine measurements, 0 if none. Separates “no creatinine at all” from “creatinine drawn, but not near a mark”


death_lt / death_days_lt
Death at any time with a date from the RPDR Date_Of_Death. An input to death_days_any, not used directly as a competing event


rpdr_deceased
RPDR Vital_status is not “Not reported as deceased”. Exceeds death_lt because some deaths are recorded without a date


cmp_time_aki_365 / cmp_status_aki_365
Competing-risk pair for AKI, administratively censored at 365 days


cmp_time_ckd_composite / cmp_status_ckd_composite
Competing-risk pair for the CKD composite, any time post-baseline


death_days_any / death_any
Death at any time: the union of the two sources — RPDR Date_Of_Death when present, otherwise the REDCap last-follow-up date when pt_status is “Dead”. The competing event for both long-horizon models; death_90 is capped at 90 days and cannot serve that role



Both competing-risk pairs use the project’s usual coding — 0 = censored, 1 = event, 2 = death — with censoring at the last creatinine (day 0 → last follow-up). They are built by cmp_variable_lt() (Section 3.4b) rather than cmp_variable(), which is hard-wired to the 90-day death time.
aki is not the same variable as the existing 90-day AKI_g2_90days / AKI_g3_90days / AKI_kdigo_90days; see the note in Section 5.17.

text:
3.1 standardize_colnames


Code
standardize_colnames <- function(df) {
  # Replace non-alphanumeric characters with underscore
  names(df) <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]_]", "_", names(df))

  # Reduce multiple underscores to a single underscore
  names(df) <- gsub("_+", "_", names(df))

  # Remove underscore if it's at the end of the name
  names(df) <- gsub("_$", "", names(df))

  # Return the cleaned dataframe
  return(df)
}

text:
3.3 create_drug_indicators
Parses regimen_dose free text to create 0/1 indicators per co-drug. Administered_alone = 1 when none of the 15 drugs are present.


Code
create_drug_indicators <- function(data) {

  # Create indicator for Bevacizumab
  data$Bevacizumab <- ifelse(grepl("Bevacizumab|Avastin", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Paclitaxel
  data$Paclitaxel <- ifelse(grepl("Paclitaxel|Taxol|Abraxane", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Pemetrexed
  data$Pemetrexed <- ifelse(grepl("Pemetrexed|pem\\b", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Durvalumab
  data$Durvalumab <- ifelse(grepl("Durvalumab|Durva", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Doxorubicin
  data$Doxorubicin <- ifelse(grepl("Doxorubicin|Adriamycin", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Pembrolizumab
  data$Pembrolizumab <- ifelse(grepl("Pembrolizumab|Pembro", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Etoposide
  data$Etoposide <- ifelse(grepl("Etoposide|etop\\b", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Gemcitabine
  data$Gemcitabine <- ifelse(grepl("Gemcitabine|\\bGem\\b", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Atezolizumab
  data$Atezolizumab <- ifelse(grepl("Atezolizumab", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Pertuzumab
  data$Pertuzumab <- ifelse(grepl("Pertuzumab", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Trastuzumab
  data$Trastuzumab <- ifelse(grepl("Trastuzumab|Traztuzumab|Transtuzumab|Herceptin",
                                   data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Docetaxel
  data$Docetaxel <- ifelse(grepl("Docetaxel|Taxotere", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Fluorouracil
  data$Fluorouracil <- ifelse(grepl("Fluorouracil|5FU", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Methotrexate
  data$Methotrexate <- ifelse(grepl("Methotrexate", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Vinblastine
  data$Vinblastine <- ifelse(grepl("Vinblastine", data$regimen_dose, ignore.case = TRUE), 1, 0)

  # Create indicator for Administered alone (absence of all the above drugs)
  all_drugs <- c("Bevacizumab", "Paclitaxel", "Pemetrexed", "Durvalumab", "Doxorubicin",
                 "Pembrolizumab", "Etoposide", "Gemcitabine", "Atezolizumab", "Pertuzumab",
                 "Trastuzumab", "Docetaxel", "Fluorouracil", "Methotrexate", "Vinblastine")

  data$Administered_alone <- ifelse(rowSums(data[, all_drugs]) == 0, 1, 0)

  # Other chemotherapy: any of Fluorouracil / Methotrexate / Vinblastine, i.e.
  # the partner drugs not already broken out individually in Table 1.
  data$other_chemo <- ifelse(
    data$Fluorouracil == 1 | data$Methotrexate == 1 | data$Vinblastine == 1,
    1, 0
  )

  return(data)
}

title: Ritu Project — Data Management
text:
3.4 cmp_variable
Builds competing-risk time and status for a single outcome. Status coding: 0 = censored, 1 = event occurred, 2 = death (competing event). If death occurs first, the death time and status (0/2) override the event.


Code
cmp_variable <- function(data, event_time, event_status, name) {
  # Enquote the time and status variables to allow their evaluation within the data context
  event_time <- enquo(event_time)
  event_status <- enquo(event_status)


  # Create dynamic names for the new columns
  cmp_time_name <- paste0("cmp_time_", name)
  cmp_status_name <- paste0("cmp_status_", name)

  # Add new columns to the dataset using mutate()
  data %>%
    mutate(
      !!cmp_time_name := ifelse(time_to_death_90 <= !!event_time ,time_to_death_90,!!event_time),
      !!cmp_status_name := ifelse(time_to_death_90 <= !!event_time,time_to_death_90_status,!!event_status)
    )
}

title: Ritu Project — Data Management
section: 3.4b cmp_variable_lt — competing risk over the full follow-up
text:
3.4b cmp_variable_lt — competing risk over the full follow-up
cmp_variable() above is hard-wired to time_to_death_90, so it only works for the 90-day outcomes. The long-horizon CKD / AKI outcomes need a version that takes an explicit death time and censoring time, and optionally applies administrative censoring at a fixed horizon (365 days for AKI).
Status coding matches the rest of the project: 0 = censored, 1 = event, 2 = death without the event first.


Code
cmp_variable_lt <- function(data, event_days, death_days, censor_days,
                            name, horizon = Inf) {
  event_days  <- enquo(event_days)
  death_days  <- enquo(death_days)
  censor_days <- enquo(censor_days)

  cmp_time_name   <- paste0("cmp_time_",   name)
  cmp_status_name <- paste0("cmp_status_", name)

  data %>%
    mutate(
      .ev = as.numeric(!!event_days),
      .de = as.numeric(!!death_days),
      .ce = as.numeric(!!censor_days),
      # Administrative censoring: anything after the horizon is unobserved.
      .ev = ifelse(!is.na(.ev) & .ev > horizon, NA_real_, .ev),
      .de = ifelse(!is.na(.de) & .de > horizon, NA_real_, .de),
      # Censoring time is the last creatinine, capped at the horizon. Negative or
      # missing follow-up is floored at 0 so no one contributes negative risk time.
      .ce = pmin(ifelse(is.na(.ce), 0, .ce), horizon),
      .ce = pmax(.ce, 0),
      # Event wins only if it happens on or before the competing death.
      .is_event = !is.na(.ev) & (is.na(.de) | .ev <= .de),
      .is_death = !.is_event & !is.na(.de),
      !!cmp_status_name := factor(
        ifelse(.is_event, 1L, ifelse(.is_death, 2L, 0L)), levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
      !!cmp_time_name := ifelse(.is_event, .ev, ifelse(.is_death, .de, .ce)),
      # A zero-length risk time breaks crr(); give same-day events half a day.
      !!cmp_time_name := pmax(.data[[cmp_time_name]], 0.5)
    ) %>%
    select(-.ev, -.de, -.ce, -.is_event, -.is_death)
}

3.5 pre_lab
Finds the closest lab value on or before index_date within the time window. Returns one row per patient (most recent qualifying lab result).

See Section 6.1 for the bug found in Jiaxuan’s version of this function and how Copy 709 correctly implements it.



Code
###### pre lab  index data included closest date
pre_lab <- function(data, month, time, index_date, Group_Id) {
  index_date <- enquo(index_date)
  if (month) {
    time_value <- time * 30
  } else {
    time_value <- time
  }


  lab_name <- paste0("pre_", Group_Id, "_", time_value, "days")
  lab_date_name <- paste0("pre_", Group_Id, "_", time_value, "days_date")

  result <- data %>%
    filter(Group_Id == !!Group_Id, grepl("^\\d+\\.\\d+$", Result)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Result)) %>%
    mutate(Result = as.numeric(Result)) %>%
    filter(Seq_Date_Time >= (!!index_date) - time_value, Seq_Date_Time <= !!index_date) %>%
    arrange(EMPI, desc(Seq_Date_Time)) %>%
    distinct(EMPI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    rename(!!lab_name := Result,
           !!lab_date_name := Seq_Date_Time) %>%
    select(EMPI,
           !!lab_name, !!lab_date_name)

  return(result)
}

text:
3.9 make_ckd_outcome_date — sustained-episode outcomes
Ported unchanged from ICI-CKD §3.7. Finds the first episode where a condition (e.g. eGFR_CRE < 60) is sustained for at least days_threshold days, and returns both the binary flag and the episode start date. An episode ends at the next observation whose condition status differs, so “sustained” means the condition held across every creatinine drawn in that span.


Code
make_ckd_outcome_date <- function(data, id_var, date_var, condition_expr,
                                  days_threshold = 90, outcome_name = "default") {
  id_var      <- enquo(id_var)
  date_var    <- enquo(date_var)
  cond_q      <- enquo(condition_expr)
  outcome_sym <- ensym(outcome_name)
  outcome_date_name <- paste0(outcome_name, "_date")

  working <- data %>%
    arrange(!!id_var, !!date_var) %>%
    group_by(!!id_var) %>%
    mutate(
      .cond   = if_else(!!cond_q, 1L, 0L),
      .change = .cond != lag(.cond, default = first(.cond)),
      .run    = cumsum(.change)
    )

  episodes <- working %>%
    group_by(!!id_var, .run) %>%
    summarise(.code = first(.cond),
              .start = first(!!date_var),
              .last  = last(!!date_var),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(!!id_var) %>%
    mutate(.end  = lead(.start),
           .end  = if_else(is.na(.end), .last, .end),
           .days = as.integer(.end - .start)) %>%
    ungroup()

  episodes %>%
    group_by(!!id_var) %>%
    summarise(
      has_event  = any(.code == 1L & .days >= days_threshold),
      event_date = if (any(.code == 1L & .days >= days_threshold))
                      min(.start[.code == 1L & .days >= days_threshold])
                   else as.Date(NA),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(!!outcome_sym := as.integer(has_event)) %>%
    rename(!!outcome_date_name := event_date) %>%
    select(-has_event)
}

text:
3.10 create_aki — KDIGO-style AKI from serial creatinine
Ported unchanged from ICI-CKD §3.8, with the index date defaulting to this project’s anchor (baseline_sample_date) instead of ICI_Dose_Date. A creatinine drawn after baseline flags AKI if it exceeds 1.5 × the median of the preceding 90 days, or rises ≥ 0.3 mg/dL above the lowest value in the preceding 2 days. Returns the first such date per patient.


Code
create_aki <- function(data,
                       index_date = baseline_sample_date,
                       Group_Id   = EMPI,
                       median_window_days = 90,
                       lowest_window_days = 2) {
  index_date <- enquo(index_date)
  Group_Id   <- enquo(Group_Id)

  df <- data %>%
    filter(Group_Id == "CRE", grepl("^\\d+\\.\\d+$", Result)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Result)) %>%
    mutate(Result = as.numeric(Result)) %>%
    rename(cre_date = Seq_Date_Time, cre = Result) %>%
    select(EMPI, cre, cre_date, !!index_date) %>%
    arrange(!!Group_Id, cre_date)

  df %>%
    filter(cre_date > !!index_date) %>%
    group_by(!!Group_Id) %>%
    mutate(
      median_cre_90days = sapply(seq_along(cre), function(i) {
        vals <- cre[cre_date >= cre_date[i] - median_window_days &
                    cre_date <= cre_date[i] - 1]
        if (length(vals) == 0) NA_real_ else median(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      lowest_cre_2days = sapply(seq_along(cre), function(i) {
        vals <- cre[cre_date >= cre_date[i] - lowest_window_days &
                    cre_date <= cre_date[i] - 1]
        if (length(vals) == 0) NA_real_ else min(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      aki_flag = (!is.na(median_cre_90days) & cre > 1.5 * median_cre_90days) |
                 (!is.na(lowest_cre_2days)  & cre - lowest_cre_2days >= 0.3)
    ) %>%
    filter(aki_flag) %>%
    arrange(!!Group_Id, cre_date) %>%
    summarise(aki      = 1L,
              aki_date = min(cre_date), .groups = "drop")
}

# CKD-EPI 2012 creatinine-based eGFR (race-free CKD-EPI equation)
ckd_epi_gfr <- function(cre, male, age) {
  k <- ifelse(male == 1, 0.9, 0.7)
  a <- ifelse(male == 1, -0.302, -0.241)
  m <- ifelse(male == 1, 1, 1.012)
  gfr <- 142 * min(c(cre/k, 1))^a * max(c(cre/k, 1))^-1.2 * 0.9938^age * m
  return(gfr)
}




Code
# CKD-EPI 2012 cystatin C-based eGFR (Inker et al. 2012)
# Age coefficient = 0.996 per official NKF/Inker 2012 (not 0.9961, which is the 2021 Cr+CysC value)
ckd_epi_cys_gfr <- function(cys, male, age) {
  gfr <- 133 * min(c(cys/0.8, 1))^(-0.499) * max(c(cys/0.8, 1))^(-1.328) *
         0.996^age * ifelse(male == 0, 0.932, 1)
  return(gfr)
}




Code
# Combined creatinine + cystatin C eGFR — exact coefficients from R code summary.Rmd
# Note: coefficients differ from CKD-EPI 2021 race-free (a=-0.144/-0.219, max_cr=-0.544,
# min_cys=-0.323, max_cys=-0.778, age=0.9961, female=0.963)
ckd_epi_cre_cys_gfr <- function(creatinine, cystatin_c, male, age) {
  k      <- ifelse(male == 1, 0.9, 0.7)
  a      <- ifelse(male == 1, -0.144, -0.219)
  female <- ifelse(male == 0, 0.963, 1)
  gfr_cr_cys <- 135 *
    min(c(creatinine/k, 1.0))^a  *
    max(c(creatinine/k, 1.0))^(-0.544) *
    min(c(cystatin_c/0.8, 1.0))^(-0.323) *
    max(c(cystatin_c/0.8, 1.0))^(-0.778) *
    0.9961^age * female
  return(gfr_cr_cys)
}




Code
# Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance (mL/min)
# Female factor = 0.85; male = 1.0
Cockcroft <- function(age, weight, male, cre) {
  if (male == 0) {
    value <- (140 - age) * weight * 0.85 / (72 * cre)
  } else {
    value <- (140 - age) * weight / (72 * cre)
  }
  return(value)
}




Code
# Adjust indexed eGFR for body surface area
unindex <- function(value, bsa) {
  return(value * bsa / 1.73)
}

# Post-baseline AE lab outcomes (from RPDR lab — original pull).
# Dates are already Date type from section 4.7; no further conversion needed.

Anemia_g2_value <- post_lab_less_than_cutpoint(
  data = master_lab, days = 90, index_date = baseline_sample_date,
  Group_ID = "HGB", Group_ID_name = "Anemia_2", cutpoint = 10)   # HGB < 10 g/dL

Anemia_g3_value <- post_lab_less_than_cutpoint(
  data = master_lab, days = 90, index_date = baseline_sample_date,
  Group_ID = "HGB", Group_ID_name = "Anemia_3", cutpoint = 8)    # HGB < 8 g/dL

Throm_g2_value <- post_lab_less_than_cutpoint(
  data = master_lab, days = 90, index_date = baseline_sample_date,
  Group_ID = "PLT", Group_ID_name = "Throm_2", cutpoint = 75)    # PLT < 75×10^9/L

Throm_g3_value <- post_lab_less_than_cutpoint(
  data = master_lab, days = 90, index_date = baseline_sample_date,
  Group_ID = "PLT", Group_ID_name = "Throm_3", cutpoint = 50)    # PLT < 50×10^9/L

# AKI grade 2: post-baseline CRE > 1.5 × pre-baseline CRE (CTCAE)
AKI_g2_value <- master_lab %>%
  merge(pre_CRE_45days, by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  filter(Group_Id == "CRE") %>%
  filter(grepl("^[><]?\\d+\\.?\\d* ?$", Result)) %>%
  mutate(Result = as.numeric(parse_number(Result))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Result), !is.na(pre_CRE_45days)) %>%
  filter(Seq_Date_Time > baseline_sample_date,
         Seq_Date_Time <= baseline_sample_date + 90) %>%
  filter(Result > 1.5 * pre_CRE_45days) %>%
  arrange(EMPI, Seq_Date_Time) %>%
  distinct(EMPI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(EMPI, Result, Seq_Date_Time) %>%
  rename(post_AKI_2_cutpoint_90days      = Result,
         post_AKI_2_cutpoint_90days_date = Seq_Date_Time)

# AKI (KDIGO): Rule 1 — CRE >= 1.5 × pre-baseline CRE
#              Rule 2 — any 2-day window with CRE increase >= 0.3 mg/dL
# Either rule triggers AKI; first qualifying date is used.
aki_kdigo_cre <- master_lab %>%
  merge(pre_CRE_45days, by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  filter(Group_Id == "CRE") %>%
  filter(grepl("^[><]?\\d+\\.?\\d* ?$", Result)) %>%
  mutate(Result = as.numeric(parse_number(Result))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Result), !is.na(pre_CRE_45days)) %>%
  filter(Seq_Date_Time > baseline_sample_date,
         Seq_Date_Time <= baseline_sample_date + 90) %>%
  arrange(EMPI, Seq_Date_Time)

# Rule 1: CRE >= 1.5 × pre-baseline
aki_rule1 <- aki_kdigo_cre %>%
  filter(Result >= 1.5 * pre_CRE_45days) %>%
  distinct(EMPI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(EMPI, aki_date_r1 = Seq_Date_Time, aki_value_r1 = Result)

# Rule 2: within any 2-day window, CRE increased by >= 0.3 from lowest CRE in prior 2 days
aki_rule2 <- aki_kdigo_cre %>%
  group_by(EMPI) %>%
  mutate(
    lowest_cre_2d = purrr::map_dbl(seq_along(Seq_Date_Time), function(i) {
      window <- Result[Seq_Date_Time >= (Seq_Date_Time[i] - 2) &
                       Seq_Date_Time < Seq_Date_Time[i]]
      if (length(window) == 0) NA_real_ else min(window, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(lowest_cre_2d), Result >= lowest_cre_2d + 0.3) %>%
  arrange(EMPI, Seq_Date_Time) %>%
  distinct(EMPI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(EMPI, aki_date_r2 = Seq_Date_Time, aki_value_r2 = Result)

# Combine: earliest date from either rule
AKI_kdigo_value <- merge(aki_rule1, aki_rule2, by = "EMPI", all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    post_AKI_kdigo_cutpoint_90days_date = pmin(aki_date_r1, aki_date_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    post_AKI_kdigo_cutpoint_90days = case_when(
      is.na(aki_date_r2) ~ aki_value_r1,
      is.na(aki_date_r1) ~ aki_value_r2,
      aki_date_r1 <= aki_date_r2 ~ aki_value_r1,
      TRUE ~ aki_value_r2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(EMPI, post_AKI_kdigo_cutpoint_90days, post_AKI_kdigo_cutpoint_90days_date)

# AKI grade 3: post-baseline CRE > 3 × pre-baseline CRE (CTCAE)
AKI_g3_value <- master_lab %>%
  merge(pre_CRE_45days, by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  filter(Group_Id == "CRE") %>%
  filter(grepl("^[><]?\\d+\\.?\\d* ?$", Result)) %>%
  mutate(Result = as.numeric(parse_number(Result))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Result), !is.na(pre_CRE_45days)) %>%
  filter(Seq_Date_Time > baseline_sample_date,
         Seq_Date_Time <= baseline_sample_date + 90) %>%
  filter(Result > 3 * pre_CRE_45days) %>%
  arrange(EMPI, Seq_Date_Time) %>%
  distinct(EMPI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(EMPI, Result, Seq_Date_Time) %>%
  rename(post_AKI_3_cutpoint_90days      = Result,
         post_AKI_3_cutpoint_90days_date = Seq_Date_Time)

# Merge AE outcomes into final_master
final_master <- final_master %>%
  merge(Anemia_g2_value, by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  merge(Anemia_g3_value, by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  merge(Throm_g2_value,  by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  merge(Throm_g3_value,  by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  merge(AKI_g2_value,    by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  merge(AKI_g3_value,    by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  merge(AKI_kdigo_value, by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE)

section: 5.6 BMI, age categories, ICI, CKD stage
text:
5.6 BMI, age categories, ICI, CKD stage


Code
# bmi: calculated from height (cm) and weight (kg)
# bmi_cat: 1=underweight <18.5, 2=normal 18.5–25, 3=overweight 25–30, 4=obese ≥30
# age_cat: 1=≤65, 2=66–80, 3=>80
# ici: immunotherapy co-administration (Atezolizumab OR Pembrolizumab OR Durvalumab)
# ckd_stage_cre / ckd_stage_cre_cys: KDIGO G-stage from the two BSA-indexed
#   CKD-EPI eGFRs. Staging is defined on mL/min/1.73m², so the *indexed*
#   variables are used here, never the _unindex versions.
ckd_stage <- function(egfr) {
  factor(case_when(
    egfr <  15               ~ "G5 (<15)",
    egfr >= 15 & egfr <  30 ~ "G4 (15-29)",
    egfr >= 30 & egfr <  45 ~ "G3b (30-44)",
    egfr >= 45 & egfr <  60 ~ "G3a (45-59)",
    egfr >= 60 & egfr <  90 ~ "G2 (60-89)",
    egfr >= 90               ~ "G1 (>=90)",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ), levels = c("G1 (>=90)", "G2 (60-89)", "G3a (45-59)",
                "G3b (30-44)", "G4 (15-29)", "G5 (<15)"))
}

final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(
    ckd_stage_cre     = ckd_stage(baseline_cre_egfr),
    ckd_stage_cre_cys = ckd_stage(ckd_epi_gfr_cre_cys),
    bmi = weight / (height / 100)^2,
    bmi_cat = factor(case_when(
      bmi < 18.5              ~ "Underweight (<18.5)",
      bmi >= 18.5 & bmi < 25 ~ "Normal (18.5-25)",
      bmi >= 25   & bmi < 30 ~ "Overweight (25-30)",
      bmi >= 30               ~ "Obese (>=30)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Underweight (<18.5)", "Normal (18.5-25)", "Overweight (25-30)", "Obese (>=30)")),
    age_cat = factor(case_when(
      age <= 65             ~ "<=65",
      age > 65 & age <= 80 ~ "66-80",
      age > 80              ~ ">80"
    ), levels = c("<=65", "66-80", ">80")),
    ici = ifelse(Atezolizumab == 1 | Pembrolizumab == 1 | Durvalumab == 1, 1, 0)
  )

text:
5.8 Platinum dosing variables


Code
# carbo / cis: binary platinum type (platin_group is now a labeled factor)
# carbo_AUC: carboplatin AUC (from platin_dose); cis_dose: cisplatin mg/m²
# cis_group: cisplatin dose tier (1=<40, 2=40–60, 3=≥60 mg/m²)
# dose_1: high-dose flag (carbo AUC≥5 OR cisplatin≥75 mg/m²)
# carbo_AUC_cat: "<3" vs ">=3" (factor, NA if not carboplatin)
# cis_dose_cat: 1=<75 mg/m², 2=≥75, 0=not cisplatin
final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(
    carbo        = ifelse(platin_group == "Carboplatin", 1, 0),
    cis          = ifelse(platin_group == "Cisplatin",   1, 0),
    carbo_AUC    = case_when(carbo == 1 ~ platin_dose, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    cis_dose     = case_when(cis == 1 ~ platin_dose, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    cis_group    = case_when(
      cis_dose < 40                    ~ 1,
      cis_dose >= 40 & cis_dose < 60  ~ 2,
      cis_dose >= 60                   ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    high_dose = factor(case_when(
      carbo_AUC >= 5 | cis_dose >= 75 ~ 1,
      carbo_AUC <  5 | cis_dose <  75 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )),
    carbo_AUC_cat = factor(case_when(
      carbo_AUC < 3  ~ "<3",
      carbo_AUC >= 3 ~ ">=3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("<3", ">=3")),
    cis_dose_cat = case_when(
      cis_dose <  75 ~ 1,
      cis_dose >= 75 ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    # Labeled cisplatin dose factor for Table 1 (NA for non-cisplatin patients,
    # symmetric to carbo_AUC_cat which is NA for non-carboplatin patients)
    cis_dose_high = factor(case_when(
      cis_dose <  75 ~ "<75",
      cis_dose >= 75 ~ ">=75",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("<75", ">=75"))
  )

section: 5.9 Carboplatin dose discrepancy variables (from Leyre dose.Rmd)
text:
5.9 Carboplatin dose discrepancy variables (from Leyre dose.Rmd)


Code
# Carboplatin is dosed via Calvert formula: Dose(mg) = target AUC × (GFR + 25)
# The actual administered dose is recorded in REDCap (dosage_mg).
# CKD-EPI Cr-Cys eGFR predicts what the dose should be — the discrepancy
# between actual and predicted may relate to adverse outcomes.
#
# carbo_dose_redcap:  actual administered dose from REDCap (dosage_mg)
# carbo_dose_cre_cys: predicted dose using CKD-EPI Cr-Cys unindexed eGFR
# dose_discrepancy:   actual - predicted (mg); positive = patient got more than CKD-EPI predicts
# dose_diff_pct:      (actual - predicted) / predicted × 100

final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(
    carbo_dose_redcap  = as.numeric(dosage_mg),
    carbo_dose_cre_cys = carbo_AUC * (ckd_epi_gfr_cre_cys_unindex_cap125 + 25),
    dose_discrepancy   = carbo_dose_redcap - carbo_dose_cre_cys,
    dose_diff_pct      = (carbo_dose_redcap - carbo_dose_cre_cys) / carbo_dose_cre_cys * 100,
    dd_gt25            = factor(ifelse(!is.na(dose_discrepancy) & dose_discrepancy > 25, 1, 0)),
    dd_gt50            = factor(ifelse(!is.na(dose_discrepancy) & dose_discrepancy > 50, 1, 0)),
    ecog_score_cat2    = factor(ifelse(ecog_score == 0, "0", ">=1"), levels = c("0", ">=1")),
    bmi_30 = factor(ifelse(bmi < 30, "<30", ">=30")),
    age_70 = factor(ifelse(age < 70, "<70", ">=70"))
  )

# steroids: 1 if corticosteroid medication dispensed within 30 days before baseline.
# The exclusion list (no_steroid_names) follows the reference definition in
# "Reference code/prospective cys.Rmd": drop inhaled, nebulized, topical,
# ophthalmic, and Symbicort dispensings so the flag reflects systemic

steroid_med_list <- c(
  "Prednisone", "Prednisolone", "Methylprednisolone", "Medrol",

  "Cortisone"

steroid_final <- master_med %>%
  filter(!is.na(Medication_Date),
         Medication_Date <= baseline_sample_date,
         Medication_Date >= baseline_sample_date - 30) %>%
  filter(grepl(paste(steroid_med_list, collapse = "|"), Medication, ignore.case = TRUE),
         !grepl(paste(no_steroid_names, collapse = "|"), Medication, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  distinct(EMPI)

final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(steroids = ifelse(EMPI %in% steroid_final$EMPI, 1, 0))

  "rukobia", "ibalizumab", "trogarzo", "lenacapavir", "sunlenca",

title: Ritu Project — Data Management
text:
5.14 Charlson Comorbidity Index


Code
### Charlson comorbidity index
ici_diag <- dia %>% subset(select = c(EMPI, Diagnosis_Name, Date, Code, Code_Type))
ici_diag <- ici_diag %>% merge(final_master %>% select(EMPI, baseline_sample_date),
                                by = "EMPI", all.y = TRUE)
ici_diag$Date <- as.Date(ici_diag$Date, "%m/%d/%Y")
ici_diag_pre  <- subset(ici_diag, Date < baseline_sample_date)

# Leukemia and lymphoma must be extracted manually (ICD code map includes them under cancer)
leukemia <- ici_diag_pre[grep("leukemia", ici_diag_pre$Diagnosis_Name, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
leukemia <- leukemia[!grepl("lymphoma", leukemia$Diagnosis_Name, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
leukemia <- as.data.frame(table(leukemia$EMPI))
names(leukemia)[names(leukemia) == "Var1"] <- "EMPI"
names(leukemia)[names(leukemia) == "Freq"] <- "leukemia"
leukemia$leukemia[leukemia$leukemia > 0] <- 1

lymphoma <- ici_diag_pre[grep("lymphoma", ici_diag_pre$Diagnosis_Name, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
lymphoma <- lymphoma[!grepl("leukemia", lymphoma$Diagnosis_Name, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
lymphoma <- as.data.frame(table(lymphoma$EMPI))
names(lymphoma)[names(lymphoma) == "Var1"] <- "EMPI"
names(lymphoma)[names(lymphoma) == "Freq"] <- "lymphoma"
lymphoma$lymphoma[lymphoma$lymphoma > 0] <- 1

leuk_lymph <- merge(leukemia, lymphoma, by = "EMPI", all = TRUE)

# Compute comorbidity scores separately for ICD-9 and ICD-10
diag_icd9  <- subset(ici_diag_pre, Code_Type == "ICD9",  select = c("EMPI", "Code"))
diag_icd10 <- subset(ici_diag_pre, Code_Type == "ICD10", select = c("EMPI", "Code"))
diag_icd9  <- diag_icd9[!(diag_icd9$Code == ""), ]
diag_icd10 <- diag_icd10[!(diag_icd10$Code == ""), ]

charlson9  <- comorbidity(x = diag_icd9,  id = "EMPI", code = "Code",
                           map = "charlson_icd9_quan",  assign0 = FALSE)
charlson10 <- comorbidity(x = diag_icd10, id = "EMPI", code = "Code",
                           map = "charlson_icd10_quan", assign0 = FALSE)

charlson <- merge(charlson9, charlson10, by = "EMPI", all = TRUE)
charlson[is.na(charlson)] <- 0

# Take maximum across ICD-9 / ICD-10 for each domain
charlson$ami      <- pmax(charlson$mi.x,       charlson$mi.y)
charlson$chf      <- pmax(charlson$chf.x,      charlson$chf.y)
charlson$pvd      <- pmax(charlson$pvd.x,      charlson$pvd.y)
charlson$cevd     <- pmax(charlson$cevd.x,     charlson$cevd.y)
charlson$dementia <- pmax(charlson$dementia.x,  charlson$dementia.y)
charlson$copd     <- pmax(charlson$cpd.x,      charlson$cpd.y)
charlson$rheumd   <- pmax(charlson$rheumd.x,   charlson$rheumd.y)
charlson$pud      <- pmax(charlson$pud.x,      charlson$pud.y)
charlson$mld      <- pmax(charlson$mld.x,      charlson$mld.y)
charlson$diab     <- pmax(charlson$diab.x,     charlson$diab.y)
charlson$diabwc   <- pmax(charlson$diabwc.x,   charlson$diabwc.y)
charlson$hp       <- pmax(charlson$hp.x,       charlson$hp.y)
charlson$rend     <- pmax(charlson$rend.x,     charlson$rend.y)
charlson$canc     <- pmax(charlson$canc.x,     charlson$canc.y)
charlson$msld     <- pmax(charlson$msld.x,     charlson$msld.y)
charlson$metacanc <- pmax(charlson$metacanc.x, charlson$metacanc.y)
charlson$aids     <- pmax(charlson$aids.x,     charlson$aids.y)

charlson <- charlson %>%
  subset(select = c(EMPI, ami, chf, pvd, cevd, dementia, copd, rheumd, pud, mld,
                    diab, diabwc, hp, rend, canc, msld, metacanc, aids))
charlson$canc <- 1  # all patients have cancer by definition

charlson <- merge(charlson, leuk_lymph, by = "EMPI", all = TRUE)
charlson[is.na(charlson)] <- 0

ages <- final_master %>% subset(select = c(EMPI, age))
charlson <- merge(charlson, ages, by.x = 1, by.y = 1)

# Weighted Charlson score with age adjustment (Quan 2011)
charlson$score <-
  charlson$ami + charlson$chf + charlson$pvd + charlson$cevd +
  charlson$dementia + charlson$copd + charlson$rheumd + charlson$pud +
  ifelse(charlson$mld == 1 & charlson$msld == 0, 1, 0) +
  ifelse(charlson$msld == 1, 3, 0) +
  charlson$diab + charlson$diabwc +
  charlson$hp * 2 + charlson$rend * 2 + charlson$canc * 2 +
  charlson$metacanc * 4 + charlson$aids * 6 +
  charlson$leukemia * 2 + charlson$lymphoma * 2 +
  ifelse(charlson$age >= 50 & charlson$age < 60, 1, 0) +
  ifelse(charlson$age >= 60 & charlson$age < 70, 2, 0) +
  ifelse(charlson$age >= 70 & charlson$age < 80, 3, 0) +
  ifelse(charlson$age >= 80, 4, 0)

# cci: categorical severity
charlson_sc <- charlson %>% subset(select = c(EMPI, score))
charlson_sc$cci <- ifelse(charlson_sc$score < 3, "mild",
                   ifelse(charlson_sc$score >= 3 & charlson_sc$score < 5, "moderate", "severe"))

final_master <- final_master %>% merge(charlson_sc, by = "EMPI", all.x = TRUE)

text:
5.15 Competing risk variables


Code
# Apply cmp_variable() to build cmp_time_* and cmp_status_* for each outcome.
# AE outcomes (anemia, throm, aki, grade_2/3_aes) are now computed from RPDR pipeline
# (section 4.9) and their competing-risk variables are computed here.

# Adverse event competing risk
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_anemia_2, event_status = Anemia_g2_90days, name = "anemia_2")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_anemia_3, event_status = Anemia_g3_90days, name = "anemia_3")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_throm_2,  event_status = Throm_g2_90days,  name = "throm_2")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_throm_3,  event_status = Throm_g3_90days,  name = "throm_3")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_aki_2,    event_status = AKI_g2_90days,    name = "aki_2")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_aki_3,    event_status = AKI_g3_90days,    name = "aki_3")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_aki_kdigo, event_status = AKI_kdigo_90days, name = "aki_kdigo")
# Composite AE: use the earliest event time across anemia/throm/AKI
final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(
    time_to_grade_2_aes = pmin(time_to_anemia_2, time_to_throm_2, time_to_aki_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    time_to_grade_3_aes = pmin(time_to_anemia_3, time_to_throm_3, time_to_aki_3, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_grade_2_aes, event_status = grade_2_aes, name = "grade_2_aes")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_grade_3_aes, event_status = grade_3_aes, name = "grade_3_aes")

# Platinum-related hospitalization (side effects: hosp reasons 1–7)
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master,
  event_time = time_to_side_effect, event_status = side_effect, name = "side_effect")

# Hospitalization by reason 1–11
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_1,  event_status = event_hosp_1,  name = "hosp_1")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_2,  event_status = event_hosp_2,  name = "hosp_2")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_3,  event_status = event_hosp_3,  name = "hosp_3")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_4,  event_status = event_hosp_4,  name = "hosp_4")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_5,  event_status = event_hosp_5,  name = "hosp_5")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_6,  event_status = event_hosp_6,  name = "hosp_6")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_7,  event_status = event_hosp_7,  name = "hosp_7")
# hosp_8–11 use their own event_status
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_8,  event_status = event_hosp_8,  name = "hosp_8")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_9,  event_status = event_hosp_9,  name = "hosp_9")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_10, event_status = event_hosp_10, name = "hosp_10")
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master, event_time = time_to_event_hosp_11, event_status = event_hosp_11, name = "hosp_11")

# Combined Immune-related AE (hosp_9) & Other (hosp_11): event = 1 if either
# occurred within 90 days, time = earliest of the two (90 if neither). All
# event/time variables already follow the convention "time = 90 if no event",
# so pmin() naturally yields the earliest event time when one or both occurred,
# and 90 when neither did.
final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(
    event_hosp_immune_other = pmax(event_hosp_9, event_hosp_11, na.rm = TRUE),
    time_to_event_hosp_immune_other = pmin(time_to_event_hosp_9,
                                           time_to_event_hosp_11, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master,
  event_time = time_to_event_hosp_immune_other,
  event_status = event_hosp_immune_other,
  name = "hosp_immune_other")

# Overall hospitalization (any reason 1–11)
final_master <- cmp_variable(final_master,
  event_time = time_to_any_hosp, event_status = any_hosp, name = "any_hosp")

# Convert all cmp_status_* columns to factor (required by tidycmprsk)
final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(across(contains("cmp_status_"), as.factor))

# Drop record 911 — all RPDR pre-baseline labs are NA (see Section 6.1 note).
# This patient's nearest RPDR labs are ~189 days before baseline, well outside
# the 45-day pre_lab() window, so they are dropped from every Fine-Gray model
# via complete-case analysis anyway. Removing them up front keeps the cohort
# denominator consistent across tables and plots.
final_master <- final_master %>% filter(record_id != 911)

title: Ritu Project — Data Management
section: 5.16 Longitudinal creatinine → eGFR trajectory & CKD outcomes
text:
5.16 Longitudinal creatinine → eGFR trajectory & CKD outcomes
Ported from the ICI-CKD project (§5.7), re-anchored to this project’s index date and baseline creatinine:







ICI-CKD
Ritu project




ICI_Dose_Date
baseline_sample_date (first platinum dose)


pre_CRE_180days
pre_CRE_45days (this pipeline’s pre-baseline window)



Every creatinine drawn after the baseline draw is converted to an eGFR with the same race-free 2021 CKD-EPI function already used for baseline_cre_egfr, and compared against the patient’s own baseline eGFR.
These are long-horizon outcomes, unlike everything else in this pipeline. A qualifying episode must be sustained for ≥ 90 days, so unlike the 90-day anemia / thrombocytopenia / AKI / hospitalization outcomes, these use the full length of RPDR creatinine follow-up (through 2026) and are not censored at day 90.


Code
# Vectorised CKD-EPI creatinine eGFR (function defined in Section 4.8)
gfr_calc <- Vectorize(ckd_epi_gfr)

cre_long <- master_lab %>%
  filter(Group_Id == "CRE", grepl("^\\d+\\.\\d+$", Result)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Result)) %>%
  mutate(Result = as.numeric(Result)) %>%
  select(EMPI, Seq_Date_Time, Result) %>%
  inner_join(final_master %>%
               select(EMPI, male, age, pre_CRE_45days, pre_CRE_45days_date),
             by = "EMPI") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pre_CRE_45days_date), Seq_Date_Time > pre_CRE_45days_date) %>%
  rename(cre = Result, eGFR_CRE_date = Seq_Date_Time,
         eGFR_CRE_baseline_date = pre_CRE_45days_date)

cre_long$eGFR_CRE_baseline <- gfr_calc(cre_long$pre_CRE_45days,
                                       cre_long$male, cre_long$age)
cre_long$eGFR_CRE          <- gfr_calc(cre_long$cre, cre_long$male, cre_long$age)

egfr_traj <- cre_long %>%
  select(EMPI, eGFR_CRE_baseline, eGFR_CRE_baseline_date,
         eGFR_CRE, eGFR_CRE_date) %>%
  mutate(pct_drop = round((eGFR_CRE_baseline - eGFR_CRE) / eGFR_CRE_baseline, 3)) %>%
  arrange(EMPI, eGFR_CRE_date)

cat("Patients with >=1 post-baseline creatinine:", dplyr::n_distinct(egfr_traj$EMPI), "\n")


Patients with >=1 post-baseline creatinine: 936 


Code
cat("Post-baseline creatinine measurements:", nrow(egfr_traj), "\n")


Post-baseline creatinine measurements: 29086 


Code
# CKD incidence: started >= 60, fell below 60 with a >25 % drop, sustained >=90d.
# Threshold was >30 % in the original ICI-CKD port; lowered to >25 % on request.
ckd_incidence <- make_ckd_outcome_date(
  data = egfr_traj, id_var = EMPI, date_var = eGFR_CRE_date,
  condition_expr = pct_drop > 0.25 & eGFR_CRE < 60 & eGFR_CRE_baseline >= 60,
  days_threshold = 90, outcome_name = "ckd_incidence")

# CKD incidence (any): started >= 60 and fell below 60 for >=90d, with NO
# percent-drop requirement. The more inclusive definition; reported alongside
# ckd_incidence, and a strict superset of it.
ckd_incidence_any <- make_ckd_outcome_date(
  data = egfr_traj, id_var = EMPI, date_var = eGFR_CRE_date,
  condition_expr = eGFR_CRE < 60 & eGFR_CRE_baseline >= 60,
  days_threshold = 90, outcome_name = "ckd_incidence_any")

# CKD progression: already < 60 at baseline AND a further >30 % drop, sustained
# >=90d. The percent-drop requirement is new -- the previous definition was just
# "eGFR < 60 at baseline and after", which counted stable CKD as progression.
ckd_progression <- make_ckd_outcome_date(
  data = egfr_traj, id_var = EMPI, date_var = eGFR_CRE_date,
  condition_expr = pct_drop > 0.30 & eGFR_CRE_baseline < 60,
  days_threshold = 90, outcome_name = "ckd_progression")

eskd_defination_1 <- make_ckd_outcome_date(
  data = egfr_traj, id_var = EMPI, date_var = eGFR_CRE_date,
  condition_expr = eGFR_CRE < 10,
  days_threshold = 90, outcome_name = "eskd_defination_1")

# Baseline numeric KDIGO stage (1-5) from the same baseline eGFR the outcomes use
baseline_stage <- egfr_traj %>%
  distinct(EMPI, eGFR_CRE_baseline) %>%
  mutate(ckd_stage_baseline = sapply(eGFR_CRE_baseline, get_ckd_stage)) %>%
  select(EMPI, eGFR_CRE_baseline, ckd_stage_baseline)

# Last creatinine date -> censoring time for the long-horizon outcomes
last_cre <- master_lab %>%
  filter(Group_Id == "CRE", grepl("^\\d+\\.\\d+$", Result)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Result)) %>%
  arrange(EMPI, desc(Seq_Date_Time)) %>%
  distinct(EMPI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename(last_cre_date = Seq_Date_Time) %>%
  select(EMPI, last_cre_date)

final_master <- final_master %>%
  left_join(ckd_incidence,     by = "EMPI") %>%
  left_join(ckd_incidence_any, by = "EMPI") %>%
  left_join(ckd_progression,   by = "EMPI") %>%
  left_join(eskd_defination_1, by = "EMPI") %>%
  left_join(baseline_stage,    by = "EMPI") %>%
  left_join(last_cre,          by = "EMPI") %>%
  mutate(across(c(ckd_incidence, ckd_incidence_any, ckd_progression,
                  eskd_defination_1),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), 0L, as.integer(.x))))

title: Ritu Project — Data Management
text:
5.17 AKI from serial creatinine (KDIGO-style)
Ported from ICI-CKD §5.11 / §3.8, anchored at baseline_sample_date.

Distinct from the existing 90-day AKI variables. AKI_g2_90days, AKI_g3_90days and AKI_kdigo_90days are CTCAE/KDIGO grades restricted to the 90-day window and referenced to pre_CRE_45days. aki here is the ICI-CKD definition — a rolling comparison against each patient’s own recent creatinine, over the entire post-baseline record. Both are kept; they answer different questions and will not agree.



Code
aki_df <- create_aki(master_lab,
                     index_date = baseline_sample_date,
                     Group_Id   = EMPI,
                     median_window_days = 90,
                     lowest_window_days = 2)

# create_aki() returns the FIRST qualifying creatinine at any time post-baseline.
# AKI is then restricted to within 1 year of baseline, as specified. aki_date /
# aki_days describe the qualifying (<=365 d) event and are NA when the patient's
# first AKI falls outside the window, so the flag, the date and the time variable
# always agree. aki_any / aki_days_any keep the unrestricted version for
# reference and are not used by any model.
final_master <- final_master %>%
  left_join(aki_df, by = "EMPI") %>%
  mutate(
    aki_any      = ifelse(is.na(aki), 0L, as.integer(aki)),
    aki_date_any = aki_date,
    aki_days_any = as.numeric(aki_date - baseline_sample_date),
    aki          = ifelse(!is.na(aki_days_any) & aki_days_any <= 365, 1L, 0L),
    aki_date     = as.Date(ifelse(aki == 1, aki_date_any, NA), origin = "1970-01-01"),
    aki_days     = ifelse(aki == 1, aki_days_any, NA_real_)
  )

cat("AKI within 1 year:", sum(final_master$aki == 1), "of", nrow(final_master),
    " | AKI at any time (reference):", sum(final_master$aki_any == 1), "\n")


AKI within 1 year: 198 of 943  | AKI at any time (reference): 243

text:
5.18 ESRD / kidney transplant from RPDR diagnoses
Ported from ICI-CKD §5.4 / §8.1. The ICD-9 / ICD-10 list is reproduced exactly.

The Ritu_project RPDR pull is creatinine only — it contains no Dia file — so these diagnosis-based variables are read from the original 2026-03-19 diagnosis extract, which is the only source for them.

Note that dia_list_icd() matches with grepl() on the joined code vector, so matching is by substring and . is a regex wildcard: T86.1 also captures T86.10–T86.19. This is the source project’s behaviour, kept unchanged.


Code
esrd_kt_codes <- c("585.6","N18.6","V45.1","Z94.0","Z99.2","996.81","T86.1","T86.10",
                   "T86.11","T86.12","T86.13","T86.19","N18.0","V56.1","Z49.0","Z49.1","Z49.2")

esrd_kt_after <- dia_list_icd_after_index(master_dia, icd_code = esrd_kt_codes,
                                          index_date = baseline_sample_date) %>%
  rename(esrd_kt_after_ici_date = first_event_date)

final_master <- final_master %>%
  mutate(esrd_kt = ifelse(EMPI %in% esrd_kt_list$EMPI, 1L, 0L)) %>%
  left_join(esrd_kt_after, by = "EMPI") %>%
  mutate(esrd_kt_after_ici = ifelse(!is.na(esrd_kt_after_ici_date), 1L, 0L))
